mapper.insert: insert into nfc_tags (house_id, tag_uid, target_type, target_id, rabbit_id, record_id, request_id, remark, create_by, update_by) values (#{item.houseId}, #{item.tagUid}, #{item.targetType}, #{item.targetId}, #{item.rabbitId}, #{item.recordId}, #{item.requestId}, #{item.remark}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.updateBy}) on duplicate key update house_id = values(house_id), tag_uid = values(tag_uid), target_type = values(target_type), target_id = values(target_id), rabbit_id = values(rabbit_id), record_id = values(record_id), request_id = values(request_id), remark = values(remark), update_by = values(update_by), update_time = now()
mapper.select: select c.id as cageId, c.cage_number as cageNumber, c.row_code as rowCode, c.layer_index as layerIndex, c.position_index as positionIndex, n.tag_uid as genericTagUid, ct.tag_uid as cageTagUid from cages c left join nfc_tags n on n.house_id = c.house_id and n.target_type = 'CAGE' and n.target_id = c.id left join cage_nfc_tags ct on ct.house_id = c.house_id and ct.cage_id = c.id where c.house_id = #{houseId} and c.is_enabled = true order by c.id asc
